review_model: dual-track: migration fidelity + latest semantic target under current LEARNING_CONTRACT; historical authority is evidence, not immutable truth

core.rule: all other historical R21 Core targets are defective or require a latest-target upgrade at current evidence

severe_examples.word:storm: Current still defines ordinary storm with a fixed 64–72-knot threshold rather than a general violent atmospheric disturbance.
severe_examples.word:straight: Current lacks the common neutral identity adjective straight = heterosexual.
severe_examples.word:stream: Current lacks modern digital streaming noun/verb access for audio/video/data.
severe_examples.word:style: Current still exposes style-guide and botanical style material as ordinary active competition instead of lower/domain material.
severe_examples.word:submerge: Current owns only the transitive put-under branch and lacks the ordinary intransitive go/become submerged branch.
severe_examples.word:suicide: Current still contains the dated/insensitive person-label noun a suicide; learner-facing wording needs usage control.
severe_examples.word:sweat: Current foregrounds condensation on a cold surface ahead of bodily perspiration, inverting learner value.
severe_examples.word:switch: Current learner Active centers the switch device while ordinary change/replace verb access is not properly owned.
severe_examples.word:take: Current does not yet provide the controlled high-value polysemy and construction model needed for this exceptionally frequent verb.
severe_examples.word:technology: Current still defines technology too narrowly through science applied to commerce/industry rather than practical tools, methods, systems and applied knowledge.
severe_examples.word:temperature: Current secondary branch is generic body sensation of heat/cold rather than the high-value have/run a temperature = have a fever construction.
severe_examples.word:their: Current learner meaning is plural-only and does not correctly own standard singular-they possession.
severe_examples.word:theirs: Current learner meaning is plural-only and does not correctly own standard singular-they possession.
severe_examples.word:them: Current object-pronoun model does not correctly own standard singular they/them use.
severe_examples.word:they: Current lacks standard singular they for an unknown/unspecified person and for people who use they pronouns.
severe_examples.word:thought: Past/past participle thought of think is still represented as lexical sense material instead of grammatical form identity.

fresh_semantic_judgments.latest: Current Core already cleanly covers hit/attack, work stoppage and sudden impression/thought; missing strike a balance/deal remains Expansion debt rather than a Core rewrite.
Current medical stroke, movement/mark in writing/sport/swimming and gentle-touch organization is learner-usable.
Current distinguishes physical trip/hesitation from chance discovery and already owns stumble across; no Core rewrite is required.
Keep the explicit BrE table = submit for discussion versus AmE table = postpone distinction in the Word owner; do not create a fake cross-word Relation.
Current broad specialized/practical-technical adjective model is already better than dictionary-style duplicate adjective rows.
Current theory/hypothesis-based versus practical contrast is already adequately consolidated for learner use.
Preserve direct/uncurved/continuous/frank meanings and add the common neutral identity adjective straight = heterosexual with appropriate scope.
Add modern digital streaming noun/verb access for audio, video and data while preserving physical-flow and continuous-sequence models.
Center the act/death by suicide and avoid learner-front labeling a person as a suicide; any historical person-label use must be clearly marked dated/insensitive.
Bodily perspiration noun/verb is Core and first-line; condensation is a secondary physical extension.
Own both the switch device and ordinary change/replace verb as Core; railroad and dated senses stay lower/domain-marked.

Use a controlled high-frequency polysemy model spanning obtain/receive, move/carry, accept/use/consume, perform/choose, require resources, and interpret/regard, with major constructions surfaced rather than arbitrary micro-sense proliferation.
Add the common informal verb for prices/sales/performance falling sharply or failing badly; retain container and armored-vehicle nouns.
Own tear as a first-class heteronym: /ter/ rip/split versus /tɪr/ eye-drop, with phrasal semantics such as tear down repaired under the correct branch.
Preserve physical temperature and explicitly own have/run a temperature = have a fever, especially BrE; do not model this as generic bodily heat/cold sensation.
Define technology broadly as tools, methods, systems and applied knowledge used for practical purposes, not only science applied to commerce or industry.
Own television both as the device and as a medium/programming domain; broadcasting-system language alone is insufficient.

Preserve ordinary plural uses and explicitly own standard singular they/them for an unknown or unspecified person and for people who use they pronouns, with the correct possessive determiner/pronoun/object roles.

Organize theory as an explanatory framework or system of ideas; scientific theory is an important domain model, not the definition of every theory, and everyday proposed explanations remain a separate lower branch.
Past/past participle thought of think belongs to grammatical form identity, not an independent lexical sense; consolidate idea/thinking/consideration branches separately.
Preserve two useful branches: careful/reflective or well-considered, and considerate/caring toward others.
Modern Core is excellent or very great/intense; historical terrifying meaning is low/dated and must be explicitly contrasted with terrible.
